parent_id: Stable source/proposal identifier, not a glyph/character identity.
proposal_id: Extractor-generated location hypothesis. Confirmation as writing and whole extent is separate.
native_source: Original logical Yale JPEG path; resolves by source index image ID/URL/hash.
native_bbox: Half-open native-pixel [x0,y0,x1,y1], top-left origin; not PDF or normalized ordinal coordinates.
caption: Inherited source caption-group identifier. Not a linguistic/Currier/hand/section label; panel mapping can be uncertain.
view_id: Physical photograph/PDF-view aid; overlapping views need not be independent pages.
source_membership: Source adjudicator state: confirmed_writing, confirmed_nonwriting, unresolved, or mixed; raster ink is not automatic writing.
source_parent_status: Whole connected evidence qualification, e.g. resolved_whole_parent vs contact/insufficient evidence; exact allowed values retained in source records.
source_extent_resolved: Boolean source qualification of observed whole parent, independent of finite mask availability.
full_extent_state: source_resolved or unknown. Unknown extent has no full physical embedding.
full_parent_coordinate: Observed-candidate coordinate or absent/unknown state, not a certified pixel-truth whole contour.
full_physical_distance_bounded: False even for finite candidate sets: no bound over all physical contours is asserted.
primary_index: Index of prespecified primary mask/field for this parent, not a favorable alternative selected by distance.
candidate_indices: Indices into candidate table and stored image-field arrays; alternatives remain separate.
candidate_id: Unique candidate-array/mask key. Multiple candidates of one parent are not independent source observations.
index: Row order into candidate image fields; inspect object schema/producer for other uses.
role: Candidate evidence role (primary, matched threshold, fragment/union, merge, slant sensitivity), not writing-system function.
correspondence: Contrast6/12 matched recovery records, with missing/split/merge flags; finite match does not certify parent extent.
split: Raster splits into components; possible physical splitting remains a separate source judgment.
merge: Raster candidate includes additional connected regions; not a proved linguistic ligature.
missing: No admitted correspondence at that contrast; absence is not nonwriting.
body_proxy: Image-layout estimate of ordinary writing body height, native pixels; uncertain normalization aid, not x-height truth.
shape64: Aspect-preserving centered binary64 array, 56-pixel support; no rotation/reflection alignment.
shape32: Sensitivity-only binary32 field; not a substitute primary representation.
sdf64: Signed raster distance field normalized using frozen code; secondary metric. Inspect code for exact sign/normalization.
candidate_contour64: Candidate-by-candidate symmetric mean contour Chamfer matrix; OpenCV DIST_L2 mask3 approximation, 56-pixel normalization.
candidate_sdf64: Secondary candidate signed-distance-field Euclidean morphology matrix.
primary_contour64: Parent-by-parent fixed primary candidate contour matrix.
observed_contour_low: Minimum distance over all observed raster alternatives, not physical confidence lower bound.
observed_contour_high: Maximum distance over observed alternatives, not full-extent uncertainty upper bound.
physical_distance_interval: Null where no full physical bound exists. Never impute observed raster envelope here.
nearest_across_all_observed_alternatives: Unique nearest reference survives admitted query/reference alternatives; not glyph equivalence.
not_excluded_neighbors: References not excluded by conservative observed envelopes. Not classes, probabilities or transitive equivalence.
rating: Direct morphology source organization:0=different,1=partial/related,2=same;U=unresolved. Binary original target uses0/2 only.
pair_id: Sealed anonymous pair identifier linked to hidden key after source ratings; not a new source parent.
sampling_method: broad_random or aspect_matched sealed pair-selection stratum; ratings never chosen by contour-nearest result.
aspect_only: Absolute native log-aspect difference, lower=more similar.
AUROC: Probability ranking of registered binary labels by negative distance, ties half; conditional on selected source judgments and pair graph.
caption_bootstrap95: Conditional endpoint-caption node-resampling percentile interval; not independent-rater or manuscript-population uncertainty.
gap_hypotheses: Separate0.35/0.55/0.75 body-proxy white-space boundary alternatives; not proved word boundaries.
UNK: Class abstention for confirmed writing or uncertain proposal as specified by object; not a new class or absence of writing.
class: Frozen V3 ST01–ST15 hypothesis label (14 accepted; consult atlas for rejected hypothesis). Visual structural organization only.
stable: Descriptor perturbation-range meets registered operational tolerance; source-visible qualification may still be unknown.
unknown_variant_sensitive: Feature varies beyond registered tolerance across admitted perturbations.
unknown_presence: Applicable property presence unresolved; not numeric zero.
not_applicable: Feature lacks applicable object, e.g. absent cavity coordinate; distinct from unknown.
source_qualified_status: Feature status gated by photograph adjudication in addition to numerical repeatability; stable raster cavities alone are insufficient.
sha256: Original file bytes digest, retained unchanged in original manifest.
stored_sha256: Canonical transport bytes digest, distinct from decompressed original digest.
logical_path: Original voynich-groundup-relative path; Windows separators normalized only in transport index.
public_path: Canonical package payload path; shared payloads do not imply equivalent evidence objects.
original_manifest_paths: Original freezes listing this logical file; originals are byte-preserved separately.
